corrections.old_text: ምን፡ ያህል ፡ አገኝ ፡ ብሎ ፤ ዘፍጥ ፡ ፵፭ ፥ ፬።
corrections.corrected_text: ምን፡ ያህል ፡ አገኝ ፡ ብሎ ፤ ዘፍጥ ፡ ፵፭ ፥ ፪።
corrections.reason: The verse numeral printed on the page is ፪ (2), referring to Genesis 45:2 (and 45:16), which was misread as ፬ (4).
The word for chess in Amharic is ሰንጠረዥ (with 6th-order ዥ), which was misread as 7th-order ዦ due to ink bleed on the right leg.
The chapter numeral printed is ፵፯ (Genesis 47), where the ፯ (7) was misread as ፮ (6).
